Bill.BriefDescription: Determining rates for the rental of county equipment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to rates for the rental of county equipment; andamending RCW 36.33A.040.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.33A.040 and 1977 c 67 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Rates for the rental of equipment owned by the fund shall be set tocover all costs of maintenance and repair, material and suppliesconsumed in operating or maintaining the equipment, and the futurereplacement thereof. The rates shall be determined by the countyengineer or other appointee of the county legislative body and shall besubject to annual review by the legislative body.
